# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

Be respectful, assume good intent, and keep technical discussion constructive and inclusive. Harassment, discrimination, threats, and publication of another person's private information are not tolerated.

Project maintainer `@nikhil-pandey` is responsible for interpreting and enforcing these standards. Conduct concerns should be reported privately rather than posted in a public issue.
